notes.title: Possible Live Action Cutscenes
notes.notes:
Hey Spice Pirates!

After making the trailer for this game I realized it would be pretty awesome to add live action cutscenes. I already have a mini-series filmed and partly edited so I might have some extra footage! I'm going to try to make it work before the release.

Keep your fingers crossed!

UPDATE: I had some issues with the footage and Adobe updates. Hopefully I can figure this out soon.
